import json,gzip,collections,bisect,sys
path=sys.argv[1]
p=json.load(gzip.open(path,'rt')); sy=json.load(open(path.removesuffix('.gz')+'.syms.json'))
libs={x['debug_name']:x for x in sy['data']}
t=p['threads'][0]; ft=t['frameTable']; st=t['stackTable']; f=t['funcTable']; rt=t['resourceTable']; strings=t['stringArray']
def name(frame):
 resource=f['resource'][ft['func'][frame]]
 if resource<0:return '?'
 lib=libs.get(p['libs'][rt['lib'][resource]]['debugName']);
 if lib is None:return p['libs'][rt['lib'][resource]]['debugName']
 a=ft['address'][frame]; table=lib['symbol_table']
 idx=bisect.bisect_right([v['rva'] for v in table],a)-1
 return sy['string_table'][table[idx]['symbol']] if idx>=0 else '?'
names=[name(i) for i in range(ft['length'])]; leaf=collections.Counter(); incl=collections.Counter(); total=0
for stack in t['samples']['stack']:
 if stack is None:continue
 chain=[]
 while stack is not None:
  chain.append(names[st['frame'][stack]]); stack=st['prefix'][stack]
 if not any('Routine::profile' in n for n in chain):continue
 total+=1; leaf[chain[0]]+=1; incl.update(set(chain))
print('Samples in benchmark profile:',total)
for title,c in [('Leaf',leaf),('Inclusive',incl)]:
 print(title)
 for n,v in c.most_common(14):print(f'{v/total*100:6.2f}% {v:5d} {n}')
